mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns during inflation spikes are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% in at least 40% of months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor cost index above its 12-month prior value signals wage growth momentum that supports corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > PAYEMS[lag1] for three consecutive months
failure_condition: Across 24 months, the 60-day forward returns during wage acceleration periods are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05), or PAYEMS growth decelerates within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 suggests supply-side constraints, which elevates uncertainty and reduces expected corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses below 50 in the current month
failure_condition: In 50 such episodes, the 5-day forward return does not average below zero (mean p-value > 0.5 in bootstrap), or INDPRO recovers to >50 within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST retail sales above 2% in the current month, accompanied by a simultaneous decline in RSAFS used-cars sales below 1%, indicates shifting consumer demand toward durable goods, which elevates equity valuations and drives positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > HOUST[lag1] by >2% AND RSAFS < RSAFS[lag1] by >1% in the same month
failure_condition: During 100 such demand reallocation events, the 20-day forward return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, the anticipation of higher borrowing costs suppresses risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Across 50 such periods, the 60-day forward return does not average below zero (mean p-value > 0.5), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% for two consecutive months in 80% of months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 3% for three months indicates softening labor market pressures, reducing equity risk premia and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 100 such softening episodes, the 20-day forward return does not remain negative (mean p-value > 0.5), or UNRATE recovers to >3% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A double-dip in INDPRO (first decline below 100, then a subsequent rebound below 98) within a single quarter signals persistent supply disruptions, which elevates uncertainty and lowers 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 AND INDPRO < 98 in the same quarter
failure_condition: During 30 such quarters, the 5-day forward return does not average below zero (mean p-value > 0.5), or INDPRO does not exhibit a double-dip pattern in 80% of quarters.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 personal consumption exceeds its 12-month moving average by at least 2%, it reflects robust demand momentum that supports corporate earnings expectations and produces positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Across 100 such demand expansion events, the 60-day forward return does not exceed zero mean (bootstrap p-value > 0.05), or GDPC1 growth decays within 3 months.
